title: Zero-shot TSFMs against the Khepri v1.5 baselines for 96-hour carbon-intensity forecasts in nine Nordic bidding zones (abstract page, v1)
note: Abstract, v1 submitted 2 Nov 2026, one author, physics.soc-ph and cs.LG, text CC BY 4.0. Three zero-shot models (Timestral-5M, Timestral-209M, Chronos-2; 8192-hour context, no covariates) have lower zone-averaged MAPE than Khepri v1.5 SARIMA and GBM on the 2025 test by 0.952 to 1.347 points; the 14-origin holdout is within the preregistered MDE of 2.989 and reported as not determined.

title: Khepri-TSFM paper (full text v1)
note: Design: hourly carbon intensity (gCO2-eq/kWh) from ENTSO-E generation, zones NO1-NO5 and SE1-SE4; daily origins 00:00 UTC, 96-hour horizon; all arms univariate, same context end. Retro test = Khepri v1.5 2025 test, 361 origins, labelled contamination not ruled out; holdout = 14 origins 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-29, after the Timestral release. Loss: MAPE over 96 hours, averaged over zones.

title: Khepri-TSFM paper (full text v1)
note: Table 3, retro, zone-averaged MAPE %: Timestral-5M 6.253, Timestral-209M 6.213, Chronos-2 6.395, SARIMA 7.561, GBM 7.347. Differences vs SARIMA -1.308, -1.347, -1.166; vs GBM -1.094, -1.134, -0.952; DM test with HLN correction, all p below 0.0001 also after Holm. Each model below SARIMA in 9 of 9 zones (H1 supported). No confidence intervals, only test statistics.

title: Khepri-TSFM paper (full text v1)
note: Table 5, holdout (n=14), MAPE %: Timestral-5M 8.415, Timestral-209M 8.005, Chronos-2 8.494, SARIMA 9.332, GBM 9.223. Differences -0.729 to -1.326 points, all inside the MDE of 2.989, so all six verdicts are not determined although four have p below 0.05. The NO5 series is constant in the holdout window and carries no ranking information. Six-zone sensitivity: retro -1.171 to -1.674.

title: Khepri-TSFM paper (full text v1)
note: Table 6, holdout CRPS (gCO2-eq/kWh): SARIMA 1.4165, Timestral-5M 1.1114, Timestral-209M 1.0733, Chronos-2 1.1198, each p below 0.0001. SARIMA quantiles come from a Gaussian predictive distribution (D-03), so the gap may partly reflect that. Contamination indicator (retro minus holdout advantage) -0.084 to 0.391, z at most 1.75, under the 1.96 threshold; low power.

title: Khepri-TSFM paper (full text v1)
note: Pins: mistralai/Timestral-209M at 9874d25, Timestral-5M at bdd20cf, amazon/chronos-2 at 29ec376; point forecast is the median; CPU only (Apple M1), about 1.8 s per call for Timestral-209M. Preregistration: tag prereg-v1 at commit 74539f2, OpenTimestamps proof, OSF submission 2026-11-02 07:49 UTC (embargoed, pending). Twelve dated deviations, D-01 to D-08 before registration.

title: Khepri-TSFM paper (full text v1)
note: Limits stated: Timestral discloses no training data or cut-off; most 2025 origins precede the Chronos-2 release; holdout forecasts were made after the truth was observed; NO1 SARIMA fit not bit-reproducible; holdout SARIMA training span shorter than v1.5; 17 to 55% of holdout hours gap-filled in NO2, NO3, NO5. Timestral weights: Modified MIT with a revenue restriction; Chronos-2 Apache-2.0.

title: Khepri-TSFM v1 (Zenodo record, version 1.0.0)
note: Software record by the same author, 2 Nov 2026, one 175 MB tarball. Says it holds code (Apache-2.0), the carbon-intensity series, all forecasts with 21 quantiles (CC-BY-4.0), the locked analysis output and the preregistration proofs (tarball hash, .ots proof, signed tag objects); gives reproduce commands and an expected output hash. Links the arXiv paper and osf.io/hncz5. Tarball not opened.

The prereg folder's last commit is 74539f2, the hash the paper gives for tag prereg-v1. A v1.0.1 deposit exists (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23912503). No stars or forks. Tags and signatures not inspected.

title: Khepri v1.5.0 (Zenodo record, the baseline source)
note: Same author's earlier artifact, 2 Oct 2026: carbon-intensity series for the nine zones from ENTSO-E generation and AR5 factors, with 96-hour SARIMA and gradient-boosting forecasts. v1.5 fixes a training bug in the boosting model (34 origins instead of 365); boosting then beats SARIMA in seven zones and loses in NO4 and NO5. The baselines are the author's own.

title: mistralai/Timestral-209M (model card)
note: Model card of the central model's weights: 209M parameters, context up to 32,768 steps, up to 1,024 steps per forward pass, 21 quantiles, past-only and known-future covariates, CPU or GPU. Weights under a Modified MIT licence (licence text not fetched in this run). Nothing about carbon intensity or Nordic data.
